headline: Brazilian Steelmaker CSN Shares Jump 9.1% Rebounding from 12-Month Low
summary: Shares of Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional jumped 9.12% on Friday, rebounding from a 12-month low alongside gains in Ternium, despite challenges from cheap imported Chinese steel into Brazil.
why: CSN is a major integrated steel producer in Latin America; its performance reflects industrial manufacturing health in Brazil.

impacts.name: Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional
impacts.why: Short-covering and value buying triggered a 9.1% share price rally from multi-month lows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Aggressive short-covering and technical buying drove a sharp price recovery off annual support levels.
